title: Word-boundary localization from intracranial activity
disposition_reason: A complete26-record fixed-grid word-start evaluator is delivered; its query exporter carries only grid metadata, not neural payloads. Authentic waveform alignment, competent acoustic/visual references and protected participant execution are still absent.

scientific_target.question: Can intracranial observations localize word starts in held people and movies beyond independently timed acoustic/visual cues, on a label-independent continuous grid?
scientific_target.known_answer: Whether each fixed grid sample lies within the frozen inclusive tolerance of any manually annotated word start; offsets and sentence-only onsets are different targets.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Brain Treebank manually annotated movie word onsets aligned to recording samples through source triggers; exact native alignment and complete word extraction remain operator responsibilities.
scientific_target.case_unit: One fixed-grid sample within a complete movie recording; predictions are collected for all grid samples in each recording.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 10 clinical participants;26 recording presentations and21 movie identities with repeated movies across people.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Prospective fixed-grid word-start decoding on public development data; not the paper balanced sentence-onset versus nonspeech ROC-AUC experiment.
exclusions: Paper experiment reproduction or sentence-boundary F1
Unseen-person/movie transfer from random word splits
Native understanding inferred from target-free grid metadata alone

inputs: Source intracranial signals with declared 2048 Hz alignment and nonpositive neural feature lags; native channel calibration/selection requires verification.
Continuous audiovisual windows for a separate fixed comparator, timed independently of target word annotations.
forbidden_inputs: Word timestamps, transcript rows, onsets/labels or answer-bearing movie identities in query metadata
Word-aligned loudness/motion rows as supposedly independent nuisance inputs
Future neural/context features and query-derived feature/anatomy selection
observation_contract.case_identity: catalog.json enumerates all26 IDs such as sub_1_trial000. Public export binds recording/fold IDs and label-independent grid start/stop/step/count; public source IDs still permit external label lookup unless transport restricts it.
observation_contract.split: Every recording is tested exactly once; fold train/test share neither person nor movie. Minimal joint person/movie components are {1,5},{2},{3,4,6,7,10},{8},{9}; all corresponding records remain grouped.
observation_contract.coverage: All26 recording presentations and all eligible uniform-grid bins; grid depends on duration/guard, not word labels. Actual HDF5 and transcript extraction are not delivered by the exporter.

primary.name: participant_macro_word_start_average_precision
primary.aggregation: Pool eligible bins within each participant, compute tie-grouped noninterpolated AP at natural prevalence, then equal-person mean across10 people.
primary.rationale: Measures withheld word-start information without label-selected query bins; AP is not trapezoidal PR area.

secondary: Per-person prevalence, bin counts and class-balanced diagnostic separately from primary
No-wrap latency-shift diagnostic on an explicitly identical interior subset
Full recording/fold coverage and null AP if a person has no positive bins

comparators.name: Acoustic/visual continuous-window decoder
comparators.inputs: Independently timed continuous loudness, spectral and motion features, no word-aligned timestamps
comparators.procedure: Operator-owned frozen probabilities under identical folds; scorer interface exists, native competent fit not delivered.

comparators.name: Constant prevalence
comparators.inputs: Training-fold prevalence with no neural signal
comparators.procedure: Valid weak predictor; constant AP equals test prevalence as a diagnostic.

comparators.name: Latency-shifted neural probabilities
comparators.inputs: Same candidate outputs shifted beyond tolerance and feature support
comparators.procedure: Implemented no-wrap diagnostic; not a universal null under arbitrary autocorrelation.

nuisance_controls: Use whole person/movie connected components to block repeated stimulus leakage.
Define a uniform query grid before labels; balancing weights may be diagnostic but cannot label-select query timestamps.
Prevent source transcript feature row dropping from silently changing word population.
Fix word-start tolerance, sampling, lags and clipping before outcome inspection.
evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented paired participant percentile bootstrap is descriptive for10 selected clinical participants. It does not capture repeated-movie clusters or shared-fit dependence; those limits accompany any inferential claim.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject missing/extra/duplicate IDs, mismatched folds, wrong vector lengths and invalid probabilities. No-positive participant AP makes macro AP null, not an omitted participant; constants remain valid.

implementation.scorer_target: evaluator.evaluate compares complete probabilities to private tolerance-expanded word-start labels, yielding participant AP and incremental log loss. align_onsets mirrors source-informed nearest-trigger conversion; actual source equality is not authenticated.
implementation.delivered_scope: Executable standard-library evaluator and generated engineering controls covering full cohort; no neural model, native recordings/transcripts/media or competent baseline.
missing: Authenticate HDF5/trigger/transcript joins and native sample calibration across the full cohort.
Freeze scientifically defensible grid/tolerance and complete word inclusion.
Train and freeze independent continuous-media nuisance and signal references.
Provide neural-payload delivery and protected participant execution.
implementation.execution_evidence: Recorded generated numerical/alignment/split controls only; no authentic neural or model execution in this revision.

direct_observation.representation: Direct numeric or plotted intracranial windows could elicit word-start probabilities under a fixed contextual view, but no observation packets are supplied.
direct_observation.boundary: Only the declared observation/demonstration context, no external tools or evaluator feedback; a new direct condition needs an independently frozen view and complete output identity.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

typed_viewer.representation: Typed signal viewing is scientifically possible for the same fixed-grid target; no image transport or viewer-qualified response collection is delivered.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only typed render/navigation actions with audited limits; no raw arrays, labels, filenames or external source retrieval returned to the participant.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

tool_assisted.representation: The evaluator/clock converter are operator tools; a participant investigator with actual neural arrays and fixed resource budget is not delivered.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same permitted observations, frozen checkpoint tools and accounted compute as the compared arm; case state and feedback policy must be fixed before query.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

frozen_program.representation: A frozen decoder can target the strict output schema, but the package is scoring/preparation source without a fit/predict runner or authentic signal reference.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze code and fitting/adaptation recipe before queries; admit only explicitly allowed labels/calibration, retain all failed/incomplete cases.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.
